27205138b581.sentence: Felix, 2026-11-26, in the control session: 「录入密钥只用一次性网页链接，所以在没有桌面的 Linux / macOS 服务器上也能直接用。」

340fd3aa7e3f.sentence: The link listens only on the tailnet address `tailscale ip` names that is on one of this host's interfaces; with no `tailscale` or no such address it stores nothing, and its refusal names what is missing.

4bb5ad4cd9a9.sentence: `optokens --help` is the manual and its only copy; keep it true whenever behaviour changes.

756bd25d8a81.sentence: The token is `OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN` when set, else `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/optokens/token` (default `~/.config/optokens/token`). One function finds it, and every command calls it.

7b8dce016c64.sentence: `put --fields` and `init` print a one-time link and wait for its one submission, departing from agent-cli's "never ask": the owner's spec makes the link the way in for a secret a person knows, and there is no popup or terminal prompt to fall back on.

804fb0721590.sentence: A wrong path answers 404 and a method other than GET or POST 405; a POST with an empty field answers the form again, 400, with "Every field needs a value."

9aa804054b37.sentence: A Secret's values go in and out only over `op`'s stdin and stdout (JSON item templates), and the service account's token goes only in the child's environment.

9b46547fdf52.sentence: They send their errors to stderr and leave stdout empty on an error, so `$(…)` and `eval` never capture an error.

a33ca2ff2c73.sentence: Any other entry is refused, naming it and the `icacls` line that strips it (or `optokens init`, which writes the file with that DACL). Only the check differs by OS, behind one function.

b26f6dba9782.sentence: A secret value is never in any process's command line and never in a temporary file.

c811b56d1e94.sentence: `env` prints `export NAME='value'` lines on every OS, for sh, bash and zsh, Git Bash and WSL on Windows included, as mytokens prints them (ADR 0001). There is no PowerShell form yet: `env --shell powershell` is added when someone needs it.

db45976686a7.sentence: Decided by the tech lead for Felix, when this storage was planned: 「Chose: a section of its own, because a user Field may be called `kind` or `description` (a Profile's env var); keeping metadata in its own section means a label never collides with it.」
db45976686a7.why: the decision's quoted source; the same promise is registered from line 13 as label-never-collides-with-metadata

ed3cdea1b429.sentence: The page names the Secret (`<service>/<account>`) and its Description, and has one input per Field it asks for: plain text for a `--show` Field, a password input for the rest; a Field already set shows only "already set", its value never on the page, and every piece of text on it is HTML-escaped.

f1ddb985d2b9.sentence: optokens is built for agent-cli's five platforms: macOS arm64 and x86_64, Linux arm64 and x86_64 (musl), and Windows x86_64 (msvc). There is no Windows host to run the tests on, so the gate checks the Windows build with clippy for `x86_64-pc-windows-msvc`, and a Windows-only branch cannot rot unbuilt.

fa157242f70e.sentence: Every command prints one JSON object on stdout; a failure is `{"error": …}` with a non-zero exit.
